title: Support session · {{company}}
description: A time-limited, fixed-Company support workspace. Every action is checked against your current Platform permissions.

rail.fixed: The Company, reason, sign-in and expiry are fixed for this session.

close.failed: The close could not be confirmed. The session status was re-read.
activity.title: Activity in this workspace

ended.inactive.description: Company content was cleared. Open a new session from the Company page to continue.
ended.ineligible.title: Delegated support is no longer available to you
ended.ineligible.description: Your current Platform permissions do not include delegated support. Company content was cleared.

correction.title: Correct employee details

correction.unavailable: The current employee record could not be loaded.
outcome.invalid: Some values were rejected. Review the highlighted fields.
outcome.access-restricted: The Company access mode does not allow this change.
outcome.refused: This action is not allowed. Your access was re-checked.
outcome.stale: The record changed. The latest state was loaded; review it before trying again.

outcome.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. The latest state was loaded; check it before trying again.

audit.title: Scoped audit
diagnostics.title: Company email diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Inspect synthetic sample content using this Company’s templates and branding. No real credentials or Company users are created.
diagnostics.empty: No supported sample emails are available.
diagnostics.unavailable: This sample is unavailable in the selected language.
diagnostics.subject: Subject
diagnostics.recipient: Test delivery goes only to your registered Platform mailbox:
diagnostics.limit: Up to five new tests per Company in ten minutes. All your support sessions share this limit.
diagnostics.confirmDescription: Send the {{type}} sample in {{locale}} for this Company to {{mailbox}}. This uses synthetic content only. The server resolves your current registered mailbox; no recipient can be changed here.
diagnostics.evidence: This is delivery worker evidence, not proof of mailbox receipt.
diagnostics.outcome.unknown: Acceptance could not be confirmed. Check the result before replaying this same request.
diagnostics.outcome.notFound: No accepted receipt is visible yet. Acceptance may still be in progress. Check again, or explicitly confirm the same request; do not start a new test.
diagnostics.outcome.notReady: The Company sender is not ready. Review sending readiness before confirming this same request again.
diagnostics.outcome.conflict: This request no longer matches its accepted command or your registered mailbox. Check its result; a new send is unavailable.
diagnostics.outcome.limited: The sending limit was reached. Wait {{seconds}} seconds before confirming the same request again.
diagnostics.outcome.unprocessable: The registered mailbox or synthetic sample is unavailable. Review the configuration before confirming again.
diagnostics.outcome.refused: The request was refused. Current authority and session state were rechecked.
diagnostics.outcome.contract: The diagnostics contract could not be validated. Sending is unavailable.
ended.concealed.title: Support session unavailable
ended.concealed.description: This session could not be accessed from your current sign-in. Company content has been cleared.
